races.title: Midnite Golden Rose Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict: CRESTOFDISTINCTION arrives at the top of his game and is 2 from 2 on all-weather, so has plenty going for him. Soldier's Tree is the obvious threat if back to the level he showed when placed in the Wokingham, while Ain't Nobody responded very well to the switch to all-weather when just failing in a Group 3 at Dundalk and is also respected in what is a strong listed event. CRESTOFDISTINCTION SOLDIER'S TREE (IRE) AIN'T NOBODY (IRE)

races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict: An open-looking handicap in which it could pay to side with UNDER THE SUN , who has been finding his feet for James Owen in recent weeks and can take advantage of a much reduced mark sporting a reapplied tongue tie. El Fox will no doubt be popular arriving on a C&D hat-trick so she's put forward as the main danger, with Mr Fustic next best. UNDER THE SUN EL FOX MR FUSTIC (IRE)
